reviews.title: Great motherboard for AMD fans.
reviews.comment: Motherboard works well with great features!  I have a 9800X3D and an RTX5070Ti and it handles both very well.  I love having multiple NVMe drive slots as well.
reviews.author: Geek

reviews.title: Shipping issues
reviews.comment: I believe it would’ve been a great motherboard but I recived a product that I believed was damaged do to the outside box was damaged and so was the packaging. One customer service representative told me to open it and I refused to because Best Buy policy it would have been subject to a restocking fee. Until it was installed I would not know it it was defective. Delivered by FEDEX
reviews.author: ic142

reviews.title: Solid mobo!
reviews.comment: Absolutely no issues so far after installing this. Everything works as it should. Love the design with the white/silver accents, which looks spiffy in my white full tower. My only complaint is that there is only on board sata ports, but thats a non issue and easily fixed with a pci-express sata board.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.title: A great gaming motherboard! Buy buy buy!
reviews.comment: This is probably one of the most versatile motherboard out there. Solid design and excellent gaming performance. Asus has great products and warranty.
reviews.author: MarkC
